title: Dawateiqra branding + retry-friendly Internet Identity login

requirements.summary: Add Dawateiqra Organization logo branding (top nav + favicon/icons) and update app title.
acceptanceCriteria: The uploaded logo is processed into square icon assets and stored under frontend/public/assets/generated.
Top navigation shows the logo image next to the app name (replacing the current 'ProjectBrief' text-only brand).
The browser tab favicon uses the generated icon asset(s).
The HTML document title is updated to a Dawateiqra Organization title (English).

file_operations.description: Add generated centered square app logo (512x512) created from 20251231_075037.png.
Add generated favicon icon (32x32) created from 20251231_075037.png.
Add generated navigation bar logo (48x48) created from 20251231_075037.png.

Update the HTML document title to Dawateiqra Organization branding (English) and wire standard icon tags to use frontend/public/assets/generated/favicon.dim_32x32.png and frontend/public/assets/generated/dawateiqra-logo.dim_512x512.png (e.g., favicon + apple-touch-icon/other common icons as applicable).

Replace the text-only brand in the top navigation with a logo + brand text: render frontend/public/assets/generated/nav-logo.dim_48x48.png next to an updated app name reflecting Dawateiqra Organization branding (English). Ensure the logo is present in both desktop and mobile nav contexts.

requirements.summary: Make Internet Identity login failure states clear and retryable from the UI without refresh.
acceptanceCriteria: If Internet Identity login returns an error (loginStatus === 'loginError' with loginError present), the UI displays a clear error message in English and presents an obvious 'Try again' action.
If a previous login attempt left the app in a bad state (e.g., 'User is already authenticated' error), the retry flow clears the stored identity and retries login from the UI.
Login button labels remain English and do not break existing authenticated/un-authenticated states.
No new third-party authentication providers are added.

file_operations.description: Enhance the existing Internet Identity AuthButton retry UX without modifying immutable hooks: (1) consume loginStatus/isLoginError/loginError from useInternetIdentity and show a clear English error message when loginStatus is 'loginError'; (2) provide a prominent 'Try again' action that clears identity (clear()), clears cached queries (queryClient.clear()), and then re-initiates login; (3) handle the 'User is already authenticated' stuck-state by clearing then retrying from the UI; (4) keep all labels English and preserve correct authenticated vs unauthenticated behavior; (5) do not add any alternative auth providers.
